reason: A testing and debugging plugin that verifies read-only recovery-drill evidence, validates recovery phases and object hashes, and produces an evidence report without executing recovery actions.

summaries.zh: 用于验证恢复演练证据的测试调试插件，可检查清单、事件序列和对象哈希并生成验证报告。
summaries.en: A testing and debugging plugin for validating recovery-drill manifests, event sequences, and object hashes while generating an evidence report.

capabilities: Reads configured workspace files to inspect manifests, events, and referenced objects
Validates JSON and JSONL recovery evidence including phases, rollback status, stale plans, revisions, and SHA-256 references
Writes a content-addressed verification report to an explicit workspace-relative artifact directory
Provides CLI and proof-only MCP inspection and verification tools
